title: Energy bills and weather
bodyMd: An apartment cooperative insulated its roof. Heating energy use was 12% lower in the following winter. Residents attributed the entire reduction to the insulation. However, that winter was milder, and several apartments were vacant for part of it. An engineer said the insulation might have helped but recommended adjusting for outdoor temperatures and occupied floor area before estimating its effect. The engineer did not propose removing the insulation.
